value.name: Asha questions room entry during silences
value.description: Asha asks whether anyone else entered the room during the periods of silence, probing the integrity of what happened around the codicil.
evidence: asked, quiet, "Did anyone else come into the room during those silences?"

value.name: Rosa reveals she saw everything
value.description: Rosa answers by asserting that she saw the entire sequence of events, refusing to leave Asha's question unanswered.
evidence: "I saw the whole of it," she said.

value.name: Rosa bridges the codicil gap with the key
value.description: Rosa places the brass key across the codicil so it covers the gap between the date and signature, symbolically sealing the absence Daniel relied on.
evidence: she lifted the brass key and laid it across the codicil so its shaft covered the gap between the date and the signature, a flat metal weight bridging what Daniel had wanted to call absence.

value.name: Daniel freezes at Rosa's testimony
value.description: Daniel's hand stops moving at his cuff when Rosa speaks, and Asha realizes his intended argument has been shut down.
evidence: From the shadow at the doorway Daniel's hand, which had been working slowly at the cuff of his sleeve, went still
Asha understood without looking that the line he had meant to draw through the middle of the page had just been closed at both ends in front of him.

value.name: Daniel steps into the lamplight
value.description: Daniel moves out of the doorway shadow into the light and presses Asha with a pointed question about the notary's presence.
evidence: Daniel stepped out of the shadow at the doorway, far enough that the lamplight reached his face again, and asked, "Was the notary present?"

value.name: Daniel adopts a calculated tone
value.description: Daniel speaks in a level, almost helpful voice that suggests a trap rather than genuine cooperation.
evidence: His voice had gone level, almost helpful, the tone of a man laying down a plank he expected someone to fall through.

value.name: Lucia pins the key and page
value.description: Before Asha can answer, Lucia presses her palm over the brass key, holding it and the page down and forcing Daniel to stop.
evidence: Before Asha answered, Lucia leaned in and set her palm flat over the brass key, pinning it and the page beneath it to the wood; she did not look at her brother, but the small flat sound of her hand meeting the metal made him stop where he stood.

value.name: Asha prolongs the silence
value.description: Asha deliberately holds the silence a moment longer so Daniel can hear that he has finally named a group.
evidence: Asha let the silence hold a beat longer than was comfortable, because she wanted Daniel to hear that he had finally named a grou
